note: servo baseline pinned: P=32/I=0/D=32, take-up 3.5, settle/fault split

board.json.purpose: board pose in the arm frame (x, y, z, yaw) - a wrong value moves every commanded square and fails silently

live_config.json.purpose: console settings: solver (mink), move tolerance, auth posture, home pose, layout

wrist_calibration.json.purpose: wrist roll zero and the allowed roll window

mount_calibration.json.purpose: camera-in-tool mount and the arm chain - every projection and aim point depends on it
